notes: CyberSeek describes actionable cybersecurity workforce metrics and job-opening insights for the United States. Source: https://www.cyberseek.org/
CyberSeek describes career pathways based on cybersecurity jobs and transitions. Source: https://www.cyberseek.org/

ENISA ECSF defines 12 cybersecurity role profiles and describes their tasks, skills, knowledge and competences. Source: https://www.enisa.europa.eu/publications/european-cybersecurity-skills-framework-role-profiles

The annual ISC2 Workforce Study assesses workforce size, shortages, skills gaps and workforce trends using survey evidence. Source: https://www.isc2.org/Insights/2024/10/ISC2-2024-Cybersecurity-Workforce-Study

The 2024 Cybersecurity Workforce Survey - Focus on the E.U. reports EU-focused findings on workforce shortages, skills gaps, roles, industry distribution and market trends. The report does not provide a complete country-by-country table; do not treat EU-level findings as country data. Source: https://digital-skills-jobs.europa.eu/system/files/2025-03/ISC2_2024_EU_WFS_DSJP.pdf
